CustomField.label: Allowed Term Months
CustomField.description: Contract lengths a quote line may use for this product (CAT-07, spec 12.1). ARM has one term-defined selling model per pricing term, so the 12/24/36-month term is the quote line's subscription term, checked against this field (CR-13).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Contract lengths (months) allowed on a quote for this product, e.g. Enterprise 24 or 36 only.
